_doc: Which of the shared AI composer's controls Cloud SuperIntel enables (libs:ai assets/ai/ai-design.json defines them, their rows and their order). Input row: (+). Toolbar row 1: Task, Specialist | Agent, Model, Effort, Mode. Toolbar row 2: Repos, Plugins -> Skills, the four MCP buckets (KG-Graph, Cloudy infra, Cloudy user-facing, Non-Cloudy), Plugins: performance, More. Usage & Cost lives in the top bar. The persona chats (SI and the CGC experts) open on their declared agent, model and MCPs (assets/si/personas.json); the user can change them here. PersonasTest holds this file to the design. `repos` are the repositories the Repos picker offers the model (the owner confirms the list).
